source.author: cic
source.text: Illa vero deridenda arrogantia est, in minoribus navigiis rudem esse se confiteri, quinqueremis autem aut etiam maiores gubernare didicisse.
source.text_original: Illa vero deridenda arrogantia est, in minoribus navigiis rudem esse se confiteri, quinqueremis autem aut etiam maiores gubernare didicisse.
source.text_english: That arrogance is indeed ridiculous: to confess that one is inexperienced in smaller boats, but to have learned to steer a quinquereme or even larger ships.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: super onerariam nauem rudis uector inponor et homo, qui necdum scalmum in lacu rexi, Euxini maris credor fragori.
reuse.text_original: super onerariam nauem rudis uector inponor et homo, qui necdum scalmum in lacu rexi, Euxini maris credor fragori.
reuse.text_english: I am set upon a cargo ship as an untrained passenger, and I, a man who have not yet even steered an oar in a lake, am entrusted to the roar of the Euxine Sea.
